title: Beyond Success Rates: Trainability and Extractability for Offline GCRL
abstract: arXiv:2602.05459v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) methods are typically benchmarked by the success rates of optimized hyperparameter configurations. However, success rate by itself does not provide information about the sensitivity of algorithms to hyperparameters for value learning or policy extraction, since an algorithm could obtain the same success rate across a wide range of hyperparameters, or might succeed only on specific settings. We study this phenomenon in the offline GCRL algorithms GCIQL, GCIVL, QRL, and CRL under a shared policy extractor, by constructing landscapes of interaction between the learning rate and policy extraction hyperparameters such as the temperature of advantage-weighted regression (AWR). These landscapes reveal large, task-dependent differences in hyperparameter sensitivity. translated_title: 超越成功率：离线目标条件强化学习的可训练性与可提取性
translated_abstract: 离线目标条件强化学习（GCRL）方法通常通过优化超参数配置后的成功率来进行基准评估。然而，成功率本身并不能提供算法对价值学习或策略提取超参数敏感性的信息，因为一个算法可能在很宽的超参数范围内都取得相同的成功率，也可能只在特定的设置下才能成功。我们在共享策略提取器的条件下，研究了离线GCRL算法GCIQL、GCIVL、QRL和CRL中的这一现象，通过构建学习率与策略提取超参数（如优势加权回归（AWR）的温度）之间交互作用的地形图。这些地形图揭示了超参数敏感性存在巨大的、依赖于任务的差异。在AntMaze-M任务上，59%的QRL配置和66%的CRL配置达到了该方法最佳采样成功率的至少90%……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文指出仅用成功率评估离线GCRL算法并不充分，通过构建学习率与策略提取超参数交互的地形图，揭示了不同算法（如QRL、CRL）在超参数敏感性上存在巨大且依赖任务的差异。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that success rates alone are insufficient for benchmarking offline GCRL, and constructs hyperparameter interaction landscapes that reveal large, task-dependent differences in hyperparameter sensitivity across algorithms such as QRL and CRL.
